tasklist run.description: Show the help for this command and exit; no model call.
Choose the spelling used when writing new task headers; existing supported spellings remain readable. CLI overrides ARQUILO_TODO_SYNTAX.
Include the visible project preamble when present (auto), omit it (off), or require it (required). CLI overrides ARQUILO_TODO_PREAMBLE.
Working UTF-8 Markdown task list. Required for execution; not needed for help/capabilities. An existing list is resumed, not replaced.
Initialize a missing task list from this local template. Never overwrite an existing list. The destination must be inside the workspace. Explicit initialization also writes in dry-run mode.
Workspace. In the task runner, defaults to the task-list directory; Doctor uses the task-list directory or current directory. Use a narrow project directory, not your entire home.
Start selection at this task ID, for example 3 or 3.1. Already terminal tasks are not rerun. Earlier tasks lie outside the explicitly selected scope.
Stop scheduling after this task and its required acceptance. It is not cancellation of the current model call.
Maximum numeric task depth; 3 includes IDs such as 2.1.1. This does not disable a STOP barrier.
Continuation multiplier for production/correction steps: max-steps times max-retries. It is not whole-task replay after a technical failure.
Persistent invocation budget per top-level task tree, shared with descendants/reviews/Decide; 0 means unlimited. Counts attempts, not tokens, money or all internal provider requests.
Decompose unfinished work using a minimal residual contract, the legacy free decomposition, or no automatic decomposition.
Maximum direct children in minimal decomposition. Valid range: 1 to 12.
Maximum focused decomposition/repair rounds including the first child wave. Valid range: 1 to 8.
model allows the task to request a stop; controller-only instructs it to return structured feedback and leave stop decisions to the controller. Existing stop signals still apply.
Production/correction-step limit for AutoBuild. The task runner combines this with max-retries; mandatory reviews also use call budget.
Explicit execution policy. The task runner only accepts workspace-write; standalone AutoBuild also accepts read-only. Mandatory review/Decide remain read-only.
Grant shell-network access within workspace-write. A task may restrict this grant, not create it. Does not control provider, MCP or web-search traffic.

Explicit model/deployment identifier. Task runs: CLI, selected-backend environment (ARQUILO_CODEX_MODEL or ARQUILO_CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL), CFG model, native configuration. Doctor overrides require --check-decide.

Request supported effort; provider/model support is required. CLI precedes the selected-backend environment. Claude accepts low/medium/high/xhigh/max; Codex also none/minimal. Doctor requires --check-decide.
Select codex (default) or claude-code for production, fixes, review, parent review and Decide. No implicit fallback or mixed-backend run.
Skip only the selected-backend runner preflight. Per-call executable/protocol checks, sandbox requirements and mandatory reviews remain.
Skip the runner workspace-write functional probe only after that environment has been checked separately. Does not skip mandatory task reviews.
Lint and render planned work without model calls. Explicit --todo-template can still create the missing list. Does not certify provider permissions or Git snapshot suitability.
New output file for the dry-run report, relative to the invocation directory. Existing output is refused rather than overwritten.
In dry run only, mark the supplied task ID as incomplete for simulation; repeat for multiple IDs.
Optional run identifier; a new identifier is generated when omitted. Changing the identifier does not reset task state or consumed budgets.
Request commits of explicit selected outputs bound to their review; no implicit push. Capture only selected files; task acceptance and optional publication have separate outcomes.
One literal relative output filename per occurrence, not a glob or directory. Requires --git. Do not select task plans, rewritten reports or controller logs.
Additionally publish reviewed commits to the approved existing upstream. Requires --git and the documented remote/serial-execution conditions.
Require successful requested Git delivery before the run continues; requires --git. Accepted tasks remain DONE, but pending delivery yields incomplete exit 9.

Trusted external controller-state root. Defaults: ~/Library/Application Support/ARQUILO/controller on macOS, ~/.local/state/arquilo/controller on Linux/WSL, LOCALAPPDATA/ARQUILO/controller on Windows. Keep the same root when resuming.
Readable log grouping identifier, 1 to 48 characters, validated as a portable name. Bound to workspace/plan; does not merge independent budgets.
Place new diagnostic run logs in the workspace under the selected backend log directory. Authoritative journals, budgets and worker returns remain external.
Explicitly permit and record valid primary-plan edits during this run. Model-written statuses are not independent review evidence. Permission is not sticky across runs.
Adopt owner-inspected external plan changes on restart. Preserve consumption/history. Not a generic repair for an unexplained integrity failure.
Load an operator-trusted JSON runtime profile. CLI precedes ARQUILO_RUNTIME_PROFILE. A real run may execute its host preflight command.
Print the core capability/contract JSON without model execution; also available through arquilo.py capabilities.
Use the complete built-in default, de or en TOML catalog, or an explicit file. Frozen for the invocation; not a task-controlled selector.
Comma-separated explicit server selection/ceiling, or none. Codex omission inherits native configuration. Claude accepts only none/omission; no named servers or native MCP inheritance.
Subset of production MCP servers for review, or none. Explicit --mcp defaults review to none. Local read-only policy does not make remote tools read-only.
Comma-separated skill names, or none for no explicit bindings. Instruction snapshots, not permission grants. Does not disable native implicit discovery.
Approved root containing skill directories with SKILL.md; repeatable. Explicit roots replace default discovery roots.
Native Codex profile name and agent hint, not a team definition. Local CFG agent can override it. Rejected for Claude.

Use the complete built-in default, de or en TOML catalog, or an explicit file. Frozen for the invocation; not a task-controlled selector.

status lists retained publication records; retry reconciles one exact recorded publication. Both print JSON and make no model/review calls.
Required original Git working-tree root; use the same path as the task run.
Required original task-list path selecting existing private state. Relative paths are relative to the shell working directory, as in tasklist run.
Original private state base, if the task run used a custom --state-dir. Do not select a new state root to retry publication.
Exact existing publication ID returned by git status. Required for git retry and rejected for status; no model or review call.
